name: plugin.test_runner
description: Autonomous test discovery, test execution, and structured failure parsing for TDD workflows

entrypoints.name: discover_tests
entrypoints.description: Discover test files, classes, and test functions across a directory tree

parameters.name: root_dir
parameters.description: Workspace root or target directory to scan for tests

entrypoints.name: run_tests
entrypoints.description: Execute pytest on a target path and return structured pass/fail results with tracebacks

parameters.name: target_path
parameters.description: File path, test directory, or node ID to run

parameters.name: markers
parameters.description: Pytest marker expression (e.g. 'unit and not slow')
